scope: 128 actual cases:2backendsx4facingsx2intendedsizesx8root/pan pairs. Every raw actual/native/independent image and same-source equal-extents diagnostic is retained.
limitations: Actual fullChrome retains source-extent nearest-tie residuals. Equal-extents removes only verified transparent padding and is comparison-only. It is never used for published frames or the production consumer. Residuals are reported without a blanket seam/alpha/RGB waiver; visible actual join quality is for the independent judge.
localMask: Frozen finite-port rectangles from source study, each sample requires a native opaque3x3 neighborhood. Samples excluded at nonopaque silhouettes are reported in each case. Whole-frame residuals retain those samples.
